transcript:
Header: 2027-06-05 16:00 UTC | Duration: 35m | Attendees: Ava, Devon, Sofia (Redwood); Jennifer, Marco, Priya, Sam (Aurum)

Summary: quick intros, success criteria, security checklist, pilot plan, next steps.

00:00 - Ava Martinez: hey everyone, thanks for joining, uh, this is Ava from Redwood, i'll let folks do quick intros but the goal for today is to align on success criteria and the onboarding plan, and make sure we capture blockers.
00:12 - Jennifer Cole: thanks Ava, Jen here, head of AI at Aurum, excited to get started. we want to get a pilot running in the next two weeks ideally.
00:18 - Marco Ruiz: hi all, Marco, platform lead, i'll be funneling logs and request samples, and i'll own the infra side.
00:26 - Priya Nambiar: Priya, security and compliance, i'll be handling SOC2 and SSO reqs.
00:31 - Sam Ortiz: Sam, product, focus on latency and UX.
00:36 - Ava Martinez: great, and on the Redwood side we have Devon our CSM and Sofia our SE, Sofia will lead the benchmark later.
00:45 - Sofia Li: hi everyone, quick wave, i'll be digging in on perf and model mapping.
00:52 - Devon Patel: and i'll coordinate setup and the pilot environment, thanks.
01:00 - Ava Martinez: so can we go through Aurum's high level goals? Jen?
01:06 - Jennifer Cole: sure, top three: one, get inference into our clinical assistant flow with median latency under 150 ms p50, two, ensure PHI never leaves customer managed VPC, three, keep per-token unit cost around our current budget which is roughly $0.0008 per token equivalent, oh and of course compliance SOC2 type II is a must.
01:34 - Ava Martinez: ok that's helpful, sounds like Dedicated or Private deployment is more likely given the VPC/PHI requirement, we can do hosted but would need strong data isolation, Sofia any thoughts?
01:47 - Sofia Li: yeah from a technical standpoint dedicated GPU pool with VPC peering will match their requirements, we should also discuss quantization profiles to hit cost targets — 4-bit quantization on Llama family variants usually drops cost by ~40% with small latency impact.
02:10 - Marco Ruiz: are there any tradeoffs with our long context? we have some 4k+ prompts in the clinical assistant.
02:18 - Sofia Li: good point, longer seqs change batching and KV cache behavior, we might need a model variant optimized for long context or chunking strategy, we'll capture that in the benchmark.
02:28 - Priya Nambiar: on the security side, we need KMS integration for key management, audit logs retained for 1 year, and SSO via Okta, SAML. also please send your SOC2 and penetration test summary.
02:45 - Devon Patel: noted, Priya. we'll attach our SOC2 attestation and pen test executive summary in the post-call email.
02:52 - Jennifer Cole: can we get an architecture diagram of the Dedicated env?
02:57 - Sofia Li: yes i'll share a diagram; for Dedicated it's essentially a customer-dedicated GPU pool with VPC peering and optional private control plane, we can provide HSM/KMS integrations.
03:12 - Sam Ortiz: how do rollouts work? we need canary deploy and rollback capability.
03:18 - Sofia Li: rollouts are supported, we do canary, A/B, and automatic fallback to a smaller model family if SLA breaches, and you can pin model versions.
03:28 - Marco Ruiz: any limits on throughput, like concurrent connections?
03:32 - Ava Martinez: throughput is driven by provisioned GPUs and autoscaling policy, we'll work with you to size initial capacity and set burst rules.
03:42 - Jennifer Cole: timeline wise, we want the pilot to start by next Monday, is that feasible?
03:47 - Devon Patel: timeline tight but doable; i'll provision a trial Dedicated pool and send invite by Friday, aiming for pilot start Monday next week.
03:55 - Priya Nambiar: what about data residency? some of our records must remain in eu-west-1.
04:03 - Ava Martinez: we have region pinning, we can provision Dedicated capacity in eu-west-1, we'll need exact accounts and subnets to peer.
04:14 - Marco Ruiz: i'll prepare the subnets and sample traffic, what's the format you need?
04:20 - Sofia Li: a 24h traffic CSV of request timestamps, payload size, and typical prompt/response lengths is ideal, plus a few representative JSON payloads.
04:30 - Marco Ruiz: ok i'll share that by Wednesday.
04:34 - Jennifer Cole: for the pilot success criteria, aside from latency and cost, we want accuracy stability on our clinical prompts, can we include a small eval set?
04:44 - Sofia Li: absolutely, bring a labeled prompt set, we'll run regression checks and quality monitoring; Redwood Optimize can generate quantization/config recommendations tied to evals.
04:55 - Sam Ortiz: and how do we measure per token cost for the pilot?
05:00 - Devon Patel: we'll provide tokenization tooling and a billing breakdown in the console, you can export token-level cost and p50/p95 latency.
05:10 - Priya Nambiar: about compliance, do you support audit logs export to our SIEM?
05:15 - Ava Martinez: yes audit logs can be exported, we also offer retention settings and structured tracing hooks for integrations.
05:25 - Jennifer Cole: competitors — we've looked at Anthropic and OpenAI offerings — main differences seem to be pricing predictability and private deployment options.
05:35 - Ava Martinez: understood, we'll highlight the Dedicated/private options and observability controls in our follow up.
05:42 - Sam Ortiz: any blockers on our side to start pilot?
05:45 - Marco Ruiz: none, just need network peering approvals and sample payloads.
05:50 - Priya Nambiar: i'll need the SOC2 doc and your SSO flow to verify with our infosec, if you can send that asap that's great.
06:00 - Devon Patel: will do, i'll attach in an email and link to the onboarding playbook.
06:05 - Ava Martinez: ok let's recap action items — Devon will provision trial Dedicated, Sofia will prepare benchmark plan, Ava will send playbook and pricing, Marco will share payloads and subnet info, Priya will confirm SSO and compliance notes.
06:22 - Jennifer Cole: sounds good, thank you all.
06:25 - Ava Martinez: thanks everyone, we'll follow up with notes and calendar invites for the benchmark deep-dive.
06:30 - Meeting ends.

Notes: transcript contains occasional mis-transcriptions, speaker overlaps and truncated timestamps as typical of Fireflies exports. Links shared in chat: onboarding playbook doc (link sent by Ava after call), SOC2_attestation.pdf (attached by Devon).
